title: Tennis: Alex Eala battles past Valentová to reach q'finals in Hong Kong
summary: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala outdueled Tereza Valentová to advance to the quarterfinals of the 2026 Hong Kong Tennis Open, Thursday evening at Victoria Park.
